name: Revobytes Login Button for revodocs
author: revobytes

sections.description:
This plugin allows schools and educational institutions to easily add a login button to their WordPress website using a shortcode.

The button provides quick access to the revodocs application and can be customized to match your website design.

It is lightweight, easy to configure, and does not use cookies or tracking.

For more information about the revodocs platform, visit:
https://revodocs.de

Features

  • Add a login button via shortcode
  • Fixed redirect to the revodocs login page (https://app.revodocs.de)
  • Customizable button text (e.g. “Teacher Login”)
  • Option to open the login in a new tab
  • Optional button styling (colors, border radius)
  • Optional icon support inside the button
  • Easy setup without technical knowledge

Description (Deutsch)

Mit diesem Plugin können Schulen und Bildungseinrichtungen einen Login-Button für die revodocs-App einfach in ihre WordPress-Website integrieren.

Der Button kann per Shortcode eingefügt und individuell angepasst werden. So erhalten Lehrkräfte einen direkten Zugang zur Anwendung.

Das Plugin ist speziell für den Einsatz im schulischen Umfeld konzipiert und kommt ohne Tracking oder Cookies aus.

Weitere Informationen zur Plattform finden Sie unter:
https://revodocs.de

Usage

Use the shortcode:

[revodocs_login_button]

You can customize the button via the WordPress admin settings.

Support

Support: support@revodocs.de
Website: https://revodocs.de
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Insert the shortcode into any page or post.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin store personal data?

No, the plugin only stores technical settings in the WordPress database.

Does it use cookies or tracking?

No, the plugin does not use cookies or tracking.

Where does the login button redirect to?

The button redirects to https://app.revodocs.de.
